capabilities: Browse cards in a linear sequence
motivation: The author proposes that digital note-taking "customary niceties" can detract from the serendipitous resurfacing of old, forgotten ideas, which is the whole point of Zettelkasten.
problem: Traditional digital note-taking methods often include features like infinite scroll and search that disrupt the serendipitous discovery central to the Zettelkasten method.
summary: A paper-like Zettelkasten system that transforms notes into addressed cards, allowing users to browse a linear sequence and arrange them on a virtual desk.
